Anduril Unveils Roadrunner-M (fixture)

Roadrunner-M is a high-explosive variant of the Roadrunner vertical takeoff and landing autonomous air vehicle, designed to rapidly intercept and destroy hostile unmanned aerial systems. This fixture paragraph is intentionally long enough to clear the minimum body-length threshold used by the collection pipeline quality scorer in tests.

The system is managed through the Lattice software platform, which fuses sensor data and automates command and control across domains.

Key attributes

AttributeValue
LaunchVertical takeoff and landing
RoleCounter-UAS interception
